syllabus_topics: Model of a communication system. Analog-digital conversion (PCM). Time division multiplexing (TDM); TDM-PDH and SDH hierarchies.
Baseband transmission: line codes; noise models; intersymbol interference; calculation of error probability in baseband transmission systems; eye pattern.
Modulated transmission: binary digital modulations (ASK, FSK, PSK), M-ary digital modulations (M-PSK and M-QAM).
Digital Microwave Links: frequency plans; free space propagation; influence of the Earth's surface and atmosphere; ITU-R recommendations; design of a microwave link.
Introduction to satellite communications: link characterization, power allocation, multiple access (FDMA, TDMA, CDMA).
Introduction to optical communications: elements of a link, transmission windows, optical fiber structure, attenuation, distortion, fiber types, optical sources, receiver structure, design.
assessment_rules: The final grade is the maximum of (40% Exam + 10% Kahoots + 25% Lab + 25% Project) or (50% Exam + 25% Lab + 25% Project). The Exam has a minimum grade of 8 values. For Student Workers, the assessment is 50% Exam + 25% Lab + 25% Project, with a minimum grade of 8 for the Exam. For the Special Period, the assessment is 75% Exam + 25% Project, with a minimum grade of 8 for the Exam.
